sizes.bottles: 3 x 230 mm x 0.92 m, about 35 l, 200 bar

footprint.note: tow bar up; operator stands behind the panel (y about -1.5)

reference: Wikimedia Commons: US Navy 070430-N-4420S-029 nitrogen cart (public domain); 4.00-8 wheel and 50 l bottle sizes

parts.name: Frame
parts.move: root: the cart, rolls on its wheels

parts.name: Wheel_RL
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.205 m

parts.name: Wheel_RR
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.205 m

parts.name: FrontAxle
parts.move: steers about z +-35 deg (turntable), led by the tow bar

parts.name: Wheel_FL
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.205 m

parts.name: Wheel_FR
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.205 m

parts.name: TowBar
parts.move: hinge about x: 0 = up (parked) .. 80 deg forward = on the tug hitch; steers FrontAxle

parts.name: Bottle_1
parts.move: fixed: strapped in the saddles

parts.name: BottleValve_1
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..3 turns: open / close the bottle (turn left to open)

parts.name: Bottle_2
parts.move: fixed: strapped in the saddles

parts.name: BottleValve_2
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..3 turns: open / close the bottle (turn left to open)

parts.name: Bottle_3
parts.move: fixed: strapped in the saddles

parts.name: BottleValve_3
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..3 turns: open / close the bottle (turn left to open)

parts.name: Gauge_Supply
parts.move: fixed: bottle pressure 0..300 bar

parts.name: Needle_Supply
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: bottle pressure 0..300 bar

parts.name: Gauge_Outlet
parts.move: fixed: charging pressure 0..250 bar

parts.name: Needle_Outlet
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: charging pressure 0..250 bar

parts.name: Regulator
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..3 turns: set the charging pressure (turn right = more)

parts.name: Valve_Supply
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..270 deg (open): bottles to the regulator

parts.name: Valve_Outlet
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..270 deg (open): regulator to the hose

parts.name: Valve_Vent
parts.move: quarter turn about the panel normal 0..90 deg: bleeds the hose before the chuck comes off

parts.name: Lid
parts.move: hinge about x: 0 = shut .. 100 deg open (rear edge up)

parts.name: HoseReel
parts.move: spins about x: pay out / wind in 10 m of hose; the crank turns with it

parts.name: Chuck
parts.move: off its hook by hand onto the tyre or strut valve; clip lever holds it

parts.name: ReelBracket
parts.move: fixed: reel bracket, hook and the hanging hose

parts.name: Door_Cabinet
parts.move: hinge about z: 0 = shut .. 110 deg open

parts.name: ParkBrake
parts.move: lever about x: 0 = off (forward) .. 50 deg back = rear wheels braked

controls.does: lower onto the tug hitch / lift up to park; steer by hand to push
open / close the bottle (turn left to open)
open / close the bottle (turn left to open)
open / close the bottle (turn left to open)
set the charging pressure (turn right = more)
bleeds the hose before the chuck comes off
lift open / shut over the regulator
wind the hose in after charging
take off the hook, push onto the valve, clip
pull back = braked (before unhooking), forward = free to tow
